source_rows.literal: * Added [[:Category:API namespaces/C_Seasons|C_Seasons]] to support Classic Era [[Season of Mastery]].

* SharedTooltipTemplate and GameTooltipTemplate no longer inherit BackdropTemplate, see this [https://github.com/Stanzilla/WoWUIBugs/wiki/1.14.1-Consolidated-UI-Changes#tooltip-backdrop-changes section] for solutions.
* The event trace tool now supports logging events while the frame is hidden. This option is disabled by default.
* Community patch notes: [https://github.com/Stanzilla/WoWUIBugs/wiki/1.14.1-Consolidated-UI-Changes 1.14.1 Consolidated UI Changes]

: [[CVar DynamicRenderScaleMin|DynamicRenderScaleMin]]Default: 0.333333
Lowest render scale DynamicRenderScale can use

: [[CVar DynamicRenderScale|DynamicRenderScale]]Default: 0
Lowers render scale if GPU bound to hit Target FPS. Note this feature is in BETA. Known issues: May cause hitching. May behave poorly with vsync on.

: [[CVar FrameBufferCacheForceNoHeaps|FrameBufferCacheForceNoHeaps]]Default: 0
Disable use of texture heaps and force the fallback path

: [[CVar seenRegionalChatDisabled|seenRegionalChatDisabled]]Default: 0, Scope: Account
Seen the alert indicating chat has been disabled by default. (UK AADC)

model_review.grounded: Only namespace purpose and two member names.
model_review.reason: Active season identity, activation transitions and values absent; no season model found in retained scan. Placeholder numeric/default implementation unjustified.
Current profile cache configured at11507, not frozen11401. No retained1.14.1 XML template bodies; do not patch vendor or infer effective legacy inheritance from headless initializer.

model_review.grounded: Logging while hidden supported; disabled by default.
model_review.reason: Blizzard event-trace UI option, not core event dispatch. No frozen tool implementation/setting identifier retained; generic frame event registration would not exercise this option.

model_review.grounded: Existing registered getter reads per-frame text_scale; setter updates it.
model_review.reason: Candidate direct existing-state roundtrip, not a source-declared numeric/default/signature contract. FontStringSetTextScale remains literal typo-shaped identity; do not alias to SetTextScale.

model_review.grounded: Existing rilua/bootstrap paths and tests retained.
model_review.reason: Page names only, no taint/error/iteration/security signatures. Existing tests cannot confer native1.14.1/security parity; changing secure behavior from this source is unjustified.

Page omits arguments, returns, event payloads, delivery/order and state transitions. Existing clubs/chat placeholders and permissive Classic event registration are not community/network/UK AADC models. No cheap new model justified.

model_review.grounded: Four explicit lexical defaults, one Account scope, four descriptions; others unspecified.
model_review.reason: Registry read/write alone cannot prove GPU dynamic scaling, heap/cache strategy, regional disable-alert history or season notification effects. Do not invent missing defaults or implement no-op systems.

No index number/slot boundary or removal behavior specified. Do not invent number, alias renamed commentator calls, or apply modern/foreign-history retirement. Main owns same-Era successor integration.
